summary: Complaints centre on rain-flooded main roads, power and water cuts together, daily jams and a half-built station foot overbridge in Chandausi town; the start of crossing widening, rainwater-harvesting systems and pre-monsoon drain cleaning are the main recent positives.

positives.english: Work to widen the Chandausi crossing has started
positives.hindi: चंदौसी चौराहे का चौड़ीकरण शुरू हो गया है
positives.basis: ETV Bharat Hindi (6 Oct 2026): widening and beautification work began on Tuesday around 9 am at the Chandausi crossing; first step took about 2.5 hours; electricity dept shifted two poles; PWD, electricity dept and Nagar Palika coordinating. Amar Ujala (7 Oct 2026, Sambhal dateline): Rs 62 lakh sanctioned for the widening; encroachments cleared on 6 Oct; roundabout planned at centre; SDM directed PWD XEN to start work soon, so the start is reported by ETV only.

positives.english: The municipality has installed four rainwater harvesting systems in the town
positives.hindi: शहर में चार जगह वॉटर हार्वेस्टिंग सिस्टम लगाए गए हैं
positives.basis: Amar Ujala (11 Aug 2026, Chandausi dateline): Chandausi EO Satyendra Prakash said the municipality has installed four water-harvesting systems and is working on the waterlogging problem; the same report says the civic body blames old drainage and silt.

positives.english: Drains were cleaned before the monsoon, though some drains stay blocked by encroachment
positives.hindi: बारिश से पहले नालों की सफाई हुई थी
positives.basis: Amar Ujala (11 Aug 2026, Chandausi): EO said drains were cleaned before the rains, but encroachment made cleaning difficult in some places and some drains are narrow. This is the municipality's own claim, reported in the same article that describes flooding.

positives.english: Residents welcomed clearing of encroachment from the road
positives.hindi: सड़क से अतिक्रमण हटा तो लोगों ने स्वागत किया
positives.basis: Organiser (15 Jan 2026): drive on 14 Jan 2026 reclaimed nearly 19 bighas (1.239 hectares) of public land on Chandausi Road; local residents welcomed it as improving traffic flow; affected families raised rehabilitation gaps. The article places the road in Sambhal tehsil, so AC membership unconfirmed.

positives.english: 66 Sambhal and Chandausi projects worth Rs 569 crore were inaugurated (combined district figure, not Chandausi-only)
positives.hindi: संभल और चंदौसी की 66 परियोजनाओं का लोकार्पण हुआ
positives.basis: ETV Bharat Hindi (18 Jul 2026): CM Yogi Adityanath inaugurated and laid foundation stones for 66 projects worth Rs 569 crore for Sambhal and Chandausi constituencies combined; the article names no Chandausi-only project and gives no separate Chandausi figure. Weak candidate, kept only as the last positive.

negatives.english: Main roads turn into waterlogged streets after just a few minutes of rain
negatives.hindi: चंद मिनट की बारिश में मुख्य सड़कें डूब जाती हैं
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (11 Aug 2026, Chandausi): main roads, Railway Station Road and Sabzi Mandi flood after a few minutes of rain; spots named include Fuwara Chowk, Sita Ashram Road, Ganesh Colony, Sambhal Gate, Golaganj, Salim ki Puliya and Hanumangarhi; water takes 3-4 hours to recede; report says drains built for crores failed to stop waterlogging; EO blames encroachment on drains.

negatives.english: When power goes, water supply stops too
negatives.hindi: बिजली गई तो पानी भी बंद हो जाता है
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (27 Sep 2026, Chandausi dateline): on 26 Sep rain flooded main roads and power was cut around 9 am, restored around 6 pm; about 1,000 residents in Shaktinagar, Station Road and Awas Vikas were left without electricity and water; municipal pipeline water comes only morning and evening.

negatives.english: Jams at the railway gate and Bada Bazaar happen every day
negatives.hindi: रेलवे फाटक और बड़ा बाजार चौराहे पर रोज़ जाम लगता है
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (20 Apr 2026, Chandausi): jams at the railway crossing near the Kabristan last for hours; other spots named include Bada Bazaar chauraha, Rambagh Road, Kaithal Gate culvert, Saraafa and Pasrattaa bazaars and Husaini and Lakshmi bazaars; causes named: two-wheelers parked before shops, carts at intersections, e-rickshaws in markets and encroachment returning after last year's drive; traffic SI Dushyant Baliyan said staff were withdrawn from Chandausi markets.

negatives.english: The station's foot overbridge has been lying unfinished for six months
negatives.hindi: स्टेशन का फुट ओवरब्रिज छह महीने से अधूरा पड़ा है
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (25 Feb 2026, Chandausi): 12-metre-wide foot overbridge sections (about Rs 3.25 crore, made at Lucknow workshop) have lain at Chandausi station for six months without being joined under the Amrit Bharat station scheme; no completion date given, railway ADEN says soon. Station upgrade promised within one year is more than two years late. Status after Feb 2026 not checked.

negatives.english: Medicines cost many times more at Sambhal private hospital pharmacies
negatives.hindi: बाहर बीस रुपये का कैनुला अस्पताल में 234 रुपये का मिलता है
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (9 Oct 2026, Sambhal/Chandausi dateline): district-level, not Chandausi-specific (Sambhal city hospital). Cannula about Rs 20 outside vs Rs 234 at hospital pharmacy; antibiotic injection Rs 200 vs Rs 882; outside shops offer 20-30 percent discounts. Complainant Asim of Sirsi village.

notes: Identity confirmed from the Wikipedia list (31 Chandausi, district Sambhal, SC reserved). The Wikipedia Chandausi AC page names no tehsils or nagar palika, so Chandausi town (the AC's namesake seat) is treated as inside the AC; a field check of the Nagar Palika boundary is advisable. Positives remain thin: item 5 is a combined Sambhal-plus-Chandausi figure with no Chandausi project named; item 4 is on a road the report places in Sambhal tehsil (AC membership unconfirmed). Item 1 is supported by ETV Bharat for the start; Amar Ujala says work was yet to be directed. Removed: the 51-foot Ram statue (heritage landmark, not a service benefit). Searches for other completed Chandausi-specific projects (roads, drains, substations) in 2026 found nothing sourced. Not used: Amar Ujala traders' memorandum of 26 Apr 2026 (wedding zones, thela/rehri encroachment) is a good field-check candidate; Chandausi bus stand (budget sanctioned May 2026, work not started) excluded; sugarcane dues, stray cattle and hospital items found no Chandausi-specific 2026 report. Electoral figures from search summaries were deliberately not used. Overbridge at railway station: the Feb 2026 status should be re-checked since no later report was found.

round2.changes: All 9 cited URLs opened and checked (all already amarujala.com / outlet originals, no aggregators). Removed the 51-foot Ram statue item (heritage landmark) and its ETV citation for that item. Item 1 now cites ETV for the start and Amar Ujala for the Rs 62 lakh sanction and roundabout, and notes Amar Ujala's 'yet to start' wording. Positive 3 replaced by the EO's pre-monsoon drain-cleaning claim (same Amar Ujala 11 Aug article). Positive 5 relabelled as combined district figure. Negative 2 Hindi/English changed to what the source says (no tank claim). Negative 4 basis corrected: 12 m overbridge, Rs 3.25 crore, 'soon' from railway official; station upgrade delay is a separate fact. Negative 2 and 3 bases corrected to the source's wording (all-hours jams, 1,000 residents without power and water). Summary updated.
